This '''scout''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and a member of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|police force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was given the task of spying on a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Death Watch hideout|base]] on [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. The [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|police]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] returned to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to report his findings to [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].

==Behind the scenes==
The police scout was voiced by actor [[Matt Lanter]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode214.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>
